llms:
Formula r = S_xy / sqrt(S_xx S_yy) over the N listed pairs i < j. By default, x = spatial distance, y = |t_i - t_j|; supplied distanceTransform and timeTransform instead use (value + constant)^power for the respective pair values. S_xy = sum xy - sum x sum y / N, S_xx = sum xx - (sum x)^2 / N, S_yy likewise. r is undefined (NaN) when N < 2 or either norm is zero; the observed pair count N is retained. U contains only finite null statistics in slots 1 through attempted permutationCount inclusive; unused capacity slots never enter U. For fixed-count inference with M usable null draws, p = (1 + #{usable draws s with r_s >= r}) / (M + 1): one-sided (positive space-time correlation), +1 counts the observed value, ties count as exceedances. Unusable draws retain NaN slots and do not enter either tail or its denominator. If the observed correlation is undefined or M = 0, inference is unavailable (NaN), not p = 1. With stopAfterExceedances h reached, the greater-tail estimate is min(1, h / M); attempted permutationCount and usablePermutationCount are distinct.

\begin{aligned}
\term{r}{r}&=\frac{\term{covariance}{S_{xy}}}{\sqrt{\term{varianceX}{S_{xx}}\,\term{varianceY}{S_{yy}}}}, & S_{xy}&=\sum xy-\frac{\sum x\sum y}{\term{pairCount}{N}}\\
r&=\mathrm{undefined}\quad\text{if }N<2\text{ or }S_{xx}S_{yy}=0, & U&=\{s\in\{1,\ldots,A\}:r_s\text{ finite}\},\quad M=|U|\\
A&=\text{attempted permutationCount}, & x,y&=\text{distance and time-gap values after any supplied transforms}\\
\term{p}{p}&=\frac{1+\#\{s\in U:r_s\ge r\}}{M+1}\quad\text{(fixed count)}, & p&=\mathrm{undefined}\quad\text{if }r\text{ undefined or }M=0
\end{aligned}

r = S_xy / sqrt(S_xx S_yy) over the N listed pairs i < j. By default, x = spatial distance, y = |t_i - t_j|; supplied distanceTransform and timeTransform instead use (value + constant)^power for the respective pair values. S_xy = sum xy - sum x sum y / N, S_xx = sum xx - (sum x)^2 / N, S_yy likewise. r is undefined (NaN) when N < 2 or either norm is zero; the observed pair count N is retained. U contains only finite null statistics in slots 1 through attempted permutationCount inclusive; unused capacity slots never enter U. For fixed-count inference with M usable null draws, p = (1 + #{usable draws s with r_s >= r}) / (M + 1): one-sided (positive space-time correlation), +1 counts the observed value, ties count as exceedances. Unusable draws retain NaN slots and do not enter either tail or its denominator. If the observed correlation is undefined or M = 0, inference is unavailable (NaN), not p = 1. With stopAfterExceedances h reached, the greater-tail estimate is min(1, h / M); attempted permutationCount and usablePermutationCount are distinct.
